reader_verdicts.what_it_sells: Portway is software that indexes files from a connected shared drive so I can search them from one workspace during my week.
reader_verdicts.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I am a new account administrator who has signed up but has not connected a drive, so the email's request to connect my first drive directly matches my current setup stage. The email additionally assumes I have a shared drive whose files I want indexed and searched; which drive, its provider, and whether I am authorized to expose its contents are unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I have signed up for Portway and have not connected a drive.
Email-only: I manage or can access a shared drive containing files worth searching.
Email-only: I have authority to grant Portway access to that drive and its folders.
Email-only: searchable shared-drive files would be useful to me now.
reader_verdicts.problem_now: My incomplete first-drive setup is established, but no immediate need or deadline for search is established. Being able to search while indexing continues could reduce waiting later, but its importance this Tuesday morning is unknown.
reader_verdicts.stopped_at: The connection page lets you add your first drive.
reader_verdicts.biggest_doubt: I do not know what permissions Portway will request, which drive services it supports, or how much time and administrator effort the connection requires. Three minutes before a meeting, I would not start an undefined access-granting step.
reader_verdicts.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me which drive services are supported, what access Portway requests, and that I could safely complete or pause the connection in a stated number of minutes.
fixes: Rewrite "Your searchable workspace starts with a connected drive." as "Connect a supported shared drive to let Portway index its files and make them searchable," then name the supported drive services.

Cut "The connection page lets you add your first drive. Once it is connected, the first folder to finish indexing marks the point when you can begin searching its files." because it repeats the previous two paragraphs.
Add immediately before "Connect a drive →" a concrete statement of the permissions requested, whether the process can be paused, and the expected setup time.

User-supplied campaign context: {"objective": "activation", "reader_relationship": "customer"}

emails.subject: Connect your first drive
emails.preview_text: Search becomes available when the first folder finishes indexing.
emails.body:
Your searchable workspace starts with a connected drive.

Portway is a searchable workspace for shared-drive files. When you connect a drive, Portway begins indexing it in the background so its contents can be searched.

You do not need to wait for the entire drive to finish indexing. Search becomes available as soon as the first folder finishes, while indexing continues in the background.

The connection page lets you add your first drive. Once it is connected, the first folder to finish indexing marks the point when you can begin searching its files.
